archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & HIGH UTILITY POS
theme_strategy: Light & Clean High-Contrast UI optimized for Cashier Workstations and Touchscreens with Dark Mode toggle

hierarchy.price_highlight: text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 font-mono

spacing_and_layout.grid_structure: Two-column POS master layout: Left panel (Product Search, Category Pills, Product Grid) taking 60-65% width; Right panel (Customer Bar, Live Cart Table, Discount/Tax Breakdown, Payment Selectors, Action Bar) taking 35-40% width.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum tap area 44px x 44px for high-speed cashier interaction
spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: Generous inner padding (p-4 to p-6) for cart containers to avoid text collisions

key_features_and_views.name: BarcodeInputHeader
key_features_and_views.description: Auto-focused barcode input field at top of screen supporting instant scan with enter key, simulated barcode beep sound, keyboard shortcut hints (F2/Slash), and manual product lookup trigger.

key_features_and_views.name: ProductCatalogGrid
key_features_and_views.description: Category filter pills (All, Fruits & Veg, Dairy & Bakery, Snacks & Beverages, Staples, Household), search bar with clear button, grid of product cards showing high quality thumbnail, product name, price, stock counter badge, barcode tag, and tap-to-add action.

key_features_and_views.name: LiveBillingCart
key_features_and_views.description: Interactive billing panel with Customer Info Capture (Name, Phone, Member Discount), scanned items list with quantity steppers (+, -, item remove), subtotal, item discount, GST/Tax calculation, and Grand Total display.

key_features_and_views.name: PaymentAndCheckout
key_features_and_views.description: Action toolbar supporting Cash payment (with tendered cash input and live change calculator), UPI/QR payment (modal with dynamic mock QR code), Card payment chip simulation, Hold Cart option, and prominent 'Print Bill / Checkout' primary button.

key_features_and_views.name: BluetoothThermalPrinterModal
key_features_and_views.description: Status badge ('Connected to Thermal Printer - 58mm') with toggle modal to manage printer baud rate, paper width (58mm/80mm), disconnect simulation, and test receipt print trigger.

key_features_and_views.name: ThermalReceiptView
key_features_and_views.description: Authentic monochrome 58mm thermal receipt modal simulation complete with paper tear effect, store header, tax registration number, timestamp, itemized list, subtotal/tax summary, barcode, and print/close actions.

key_features_and_views.name: SalesHistoryLogPage
key_features_and_views.description: Comprehensive sales drawer showing daily receipts, cashier details, payment mode, totals, status (Completed/Refunded), and receipt re-print / order void options.

key_features_and_views.name: AdminProductManagementModal
key_features_and_views.description: Modal interface for adding new items, editing existing stock levels, setting prices, updating barcode SKUs, and toggling active inventory status.

categories.description: Assorted fresh organic vegetables and fruits
Fresh dairy milk bottle and bakery goods

testing_requirements.rule: Every single interactive element, input, filter button, table row, tab, modal trigger, payment option, and numerical counter MUST have a distinct data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement lucide-react icons for clear status and quick actions.
Ensure the barcode input at the top auto-focuses on load and after scanning items.
Implement keyboard event listeners (e.g., Press 'Enter' in barcode field to scan; 'F2' or '/' to jump to search).
Provide rich mock default products (12-16 items with real prices, barcodes like 890123456701, stock quantities, categories, and Unsplash images).
Ensure live cart tax calculation (e.g. 5% or 12% GST) and discount applications work smoothly with live reactivity.
Simulate cash change calculation when Cash payment is selected.
Simulate Bluetooth thermal printer state connected/disconnected with toast alerts using sonner or toast component.
Include customer loyalty phone lookup to auto-apply member discounts.
Add full testid attributes to every component for end-to-end automation test validation.
